'''Kortha Hatanga''' was an old [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Galax Titan]]''. The ''Titan'' served as an ore runner operating in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A sector native, he lived by the "[[Code of the Stars]]." He was a heavy drinker and made his crew earn their wages through intense work.
